source_title: Costco Wholesale Corporation Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended September 3, 2023
company_context: Costco Wholesale operates a membership-based warehouse-club model. Its economics rest on high member renewal, recurring membership-fee income, and thin-margin, high-volume merchandise sales. Fiscal 2023 (53-week year ended September 3, 2023) illustrates a stable, healthy operator: high renewal rates, growing membership base, and steady comparable-sales growth, serving as a control case of category-12 stable-healthy rather than distress.
business_type: Warehouse-club membership retail, high-volume / thin-merchandise-margin with recurring membership fees
evidence_summary: In fiscal 2023 (53 weeks ended September 3, 2023) Costco reported total revenue of about $237.7 billion with a comparable-sales increase of about 3%, and membership-fee revenue rose about 8% to roughly $4.6 billion. The member renewal rate was 92.7% in the U.S. and Canada and 90.4% worldwide at fiscal year-end, with the membership base growing to nearly 128 million cardholders. The combination of very high renewal, growing recurring membership-fee income, and steady comparable-sales growth evidences a stable, healthy membership flywheel - the opposite of a distressed condition. There is no signal of cash, margin, demand, or retention crisis; the relevant 'risk' is operational/execution discipline at scale rather than turnaround need.

source_backed_metrics.fy2023_total_revenue_usd: approximately $237.7 billion ($237,710 million); 53-week fiscal year ended September 3, 2023

outcome_evidence: Stable, healthy operation in FY2023: ~$237.7B revenue, ~3% comparable-sales growth, ~8% growth in membership-fee revenue, 92.7% U.S./Canada and 90.4% worldwide renewal, ~128 million cardholders - a high-retention membership flywheel with no distress signal.
source_limitations: Figures are from the Costco FY2023 Form 10-K on the primary SEC EDGAR domain (sec.gov) as surfaced in verbatim search-result snippets; direct WebFetch of sec.gov returned HTTP 403 in this environment, so individual lines were not re-rendered page-by-page. Revenue and membership-fee figures rounded as presented. Renewal-rate figures (92.7% U.S./Canada, 90.4% worldwide) are explicitly attributed to the FY2023 10-K in multiple search snippets.
